parts.title: February 2026
parts.html:
India hosts the AI Impact Summit

  • Dates and venue – 16–21 Feb 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi; leaders met on 19 Feb.
  • First – it was the first summit of this series held in the Global South.
  • Guiding ideas – three Sutras – People, Planet, Progress – and seven working tracks called Chakras.
  • Outcome – the New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact, backed by about 88 countries and bodies, including the US and China.
  • Organiser – MeitY, under the IndiaAI Mission.
AI summit series: began at Bletchley Park, UK (2023), then Seoul (2024) and Paris (2025); India announced its turn at Paris.

Major meets in India

  • WSDS – the 25th World Sustainable Development Summit was held in New Delhi, 25–27 Feb, by TERI.
  • Poll bodies – the ECI hosted a national meet of State Election Commissioners on 24 Feb – the first since 1999.
  • Dam safety – International Conference on Dam Safety at IISc Bengaluru, under DRIP.
  • Official Language – the All India Official Language Conference met in Agartala, Tripura.
  • PlastIndia – the plastics expo in New Delhi had the theme 'Bharat Next'.

Fairs and festivals

  • Surajkund Mela – the crafts fair at Faridabad, Haryana, had Egypt as partner nation and UP and Meghalaya as theme states.
  • Mamangam – the 12-yearly festival at Tirunavaya on the Bharathappuzha, Kerala, returned after about 250 years.
  • Arogya Mela – the National Arogya Mela 2026 by the AYUSH Ministry was held at Shegaon, Buldhana, Maharashtra.
  • Bastar Pandum – the President opened the tribal festival at Jagdalpur, Chhattisgarh.
  • Krishi mela – the Pusa Krishi Vigyan Mela at IARI, New Delhi, was opened by Shivraj Singh Chouhan.

Global gatherings

  • World Government Summit – Dubai hosted it; theme 'Shaping Future Governments'.
  • Munich – the 62nd Munich Security Conference met in Germany; the G4 met on its sidelines.
  • Seafood – the World Seafood Congress came to India for the first time, in Chennai.
  • Goa Maritime Conclave – the 5th edition at the Naval War College, Goa, gathered Indian Ocean navies.
  • BioAsia – the 23rd edition was held in Hyderabad with the theme 'TechBio Unleashed'.

parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Lawmakers and poll bodies gather

  • CSPOC (28th) – Commonwealth Speakers' meet in New Delhi, 14–16 Jan; chaired by Om Birla; 61 presiding officers from 42 countries; India's fourth time as host (1971, 1986, 2010).
  • AIPOC (86th) – All India Presiding Officers in Lucknow, 19–21 Jan; theme 'Strong Legislature – Prosperous Nation'; call for a National Legislative Index.
  • IICDEM-2026 – global election-management meet in New Delhi; Delhi Declaration adopted; India chairs International IDEA in 2026.
  • ECINet – Election Commission's one-stop app joining 40+ of its platforms, launched at IICDEM.

Big trade and industry shows

  • India Energy Week – 4th edition in Goa, 27–30 Jan (Petroleum Ministry).
  • Wings India 2026 – Begumpet, Hyderabad, 28–31 Jan; Asia's largest civil aviation show.
  • Indusfood (9th) – Greater Noida; APEDA's BHARATI scheme for agri-tech start-ups.
  • Gulfood 2026, Dubai – India the partner country for the first time.
  • Gulf events – Intersec (security) in Dubai; IRENA's 16th Assembly in Abu Dhabi.
India Energy Week: started 2023; the government's global energy platform on security, investment and low-carbon transition.

Faith and heritage events

  • Global Buddhist Summit (2nd) – New Delhi, 24–25 Jan, by International Buddhist Confederation and Culture Ministry; AI guide 'Kalyan Mitra' shown.
  • Piprahwa relics show – 'The Light and the Lotus: Relics of the Awakened One', opened 3 Jan at Rai Pithora Cultural Complex; relics found 1898, brought back July 2025.
  • Somnath Swabhiman Parv – 8–11 Jan, marking 1,000 years since Mahmud of Ghazni's 1026 raid.
  • Bagurumba Dahou – Bodo dance festival in Guwahati attended by the PM.
Somnath: Prabhas Patan, Gujarat; first Jyotirlinga; rebuilt temple opened 11 May 1951 by Dr Rajendra Prasad.

Books, theatre and culture

  • New Delhi World Book Fair (53rd) – 10–18 Jan by NBT; guest of honour Qatar, focus Spain.
  • Kolkata Book Fair (49th) – focus country Argentina.
  • Bharat Rang Mahotsav (25th) – National School of Drama's theatre festival, 27 Jan–20 Feb, 'Samvad Sanskritiyon Ka'.
  • Siddha Day (9th) – Chennai, theme 'Siddha for Global Health'.
  • Others – Lighthouse Festival at Visakhapatnam; Bharat Parv in Delhi.

Youth and policy forums

  • Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (2nd) – 9–12 Jan, by the Department of Youth Affairs, for 15–29 year olds.
  • Inclusive Education Summit – 21–23 Jan, New Delhi, by the Ministry of Education.
  • Aravalli conference – on restoring the range, titled 'Strengthening the Aravalli Green Wall'.
  • ASEAN–India Digital Ministers (6th) – held online, co-chaired by India and Vietnam.
